test_title: PYST 70: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Find the correct combination of letters that when sequentially filled in the blanks of the given series will make the series logically complete.

ABF_HI_NOP_U_WABCDH_
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: ABF_HI_NOP_U_WABCDH_

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) GMTUI → AB / F__G__HI / __M__NOP / __T__U__U__W / ABCD / H__I__

Option 2) IMTVI → AB / F__I__HI / __M__NOP / __T__U__V__W / ABCD / H__I__

Option 3) GMSVI → AB / F__G__HI / __M__NOP / __S__U__V__W / ABCD / H__I__

Option 4) **GMTVI**** **→ AB / F__**G**__HI / __**M**__NOP / __**T**__U__**V**__W / ABCD / H__**I**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95d8e7c43aa7745d1a199062e4b8254fe031c37ad432f43d1b3ddb4d829e5a5c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d26433c4dbfd8a24c0467f188ca33b2c4d53024148d3e180ac4924c9a0bd107.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****GMTVI**".
